description: My name is Abhishek Sharma. I’m interested in coding, movies, games, & creative tech. I’m really excited because it’s a great opportunity to combine technology & creativity while working with people who have different ideas & skills; and are excited to learn something new while hopefully creating something we can all be proud of.
summary: Ares Sols: 2038 is a browser-playable Martian outpost survival and mission-management simulation built in Unity 6. Set in a 10-Martian Sol period, we created an interactive strategy game where players manage essential power and life support resources; inspired by the 2018 martian dust storm while learning real NASA facts. This game will teach young to-be astronauts critical decision making skills, how to weigh various options where there is no correct answer, and many real facts, all backed up and based off of current NASA knowledge or near future plans and ideas. Plain language, in-context term explanations, zero-download WebGL access, and an end-of-mission comparison against real NASA decisions turn abstract space facts into intuitive, replayable systems thinking.
details: Ares Sols: 2038 is a WebGl based browser game built in unity 6. Players get to play through 10 martian sols and have the choice to choose between three options every sol. Every option is thoroughly rooted in science, and there is never a perfect option. Littered throughout the gameplay is plenty of opportunities to learn, from two characters that give facts and tips, plenty of pictures that relate to what's being shown on screen, and glossary definitions built into many of the words that our target age group of 7-12 year olds might not know, or would be interested to learn more. Across 10 Martian Sols with 36 branching nodes and 4 endings, it allows for replayability as players might want to explore different ways to get to the end, allowing them to learn more about problem solving, while also learning more about the many challenges and opportunities about NASA's missions. Most of the game was built in collaboration with google antigravity/gemini, and the entire design, concept, and gameplay is designed by our three team members.
